title: Avomi CLIQ Mini Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill - Red Raspberry
description: Avomi’s Red Raspberry flavour is a pure, single-note Raspberry profile highlighting bold, tangy fruit notes bursting with juicy sweetness. It offers an authentic berry experience that is vibrant and full of character. Designed for the Avomi CLIQ Mini Kit, this replacement pack utilises a unique hybrid system comprising a 2ml prefilled pod and a 4ml refill container. Together, they provide 6ml of premium Nicotine Salt e-liquid. The integrated mesh coil technology ensures rapid heating and consistent flavour production, delivering a smooth Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) draw that maximises the taste of the e-liquid. These prefilled pods eliminate the need for manual refilling or coil changes. Simply install the pod and container into your CLIQ Mini device to continue vaping. The 20mg Nicotine Salt formulation offers a smooth throat hit and quick nicotine satisfaction. Once the e-liquid is depleted, replace the entire pod and container unit with a fresh pack to ensure optimal performance. View the full range of Avomi CLIQ Mini Prefilled Pod Kits & Refills.
